correctness.rationale: For any planar convex body K and pairwise-intersecting noncollinear translates K+p_i, each normal direction gives three congruent projection intervals of length w_K(u), shifted by projections x1<=x2<=x3. Pairwise planar intersection forces range R=x3-x1<=w. Exactly one- and two-hit offset measures both equal R=w_T(u), and triple-hit equals w_K(u)-R. Integrating 0<=theta<pi via Cauchy perimeter identity gives m1=m2=P(T), m3=P(K)-P(T), total P(K)+P(T), without central symmetry or physical triple intersection. For equilateral centers and equal disks, inclusion–exclusion gives pair overlap B(q)=2(q arcsin(q)+sqrt(1-q²)-1) for q<=1 else pi q-2; triple overlap H(q)=0 for q<=sqrt3/2, 6(q(pi/6-arccos q)+sqrt(1-q²)-1/2) through q=1, else pi q-3. Exact class measures 3pi q-6B+3H, 3B-3H, H and D=3pi q-3B+H establish all q>0; H(h)=H'(h)=0,H''(h)=12 gives onset constant 6/(3+pi sqrt3/2). Independently sorted projection interval endpoints and integrated eight q values over 5000 normals each; finite quadrature checks support, not replace, the exact proof.
